messages:
Bea (CS): Heads-up 12h until SurgePilot kickoff. Theyll demo with lots of short follow-ups. Need a compact, customer-facing ops sheet focused on surge mitigation + prefill/batching guidance.
Omar (SRE): Key constraints: demo traffic can spike unpredictably. We should prioritize caps and graceful degradation over perfect latency on day 0.
Fel (AE): Finance wants hard alarms. If the pilot exceeds forecast by 30% in 24h, auto-notify AE + customer execs. Renewal conversation will hinge on unit economics.
Sasha (EngOps): Ops pattern that worked: small warm pool, prefix prefill for templates, client debounce (200-300ms), and server-side rate-limits per-session. Also expose per-route cost alerts.
Bea (CS): Draft customer-facing ops sheet (short bullet list):
- Share "Top 10 interaction templates" for prefill. Keep templates under 200 tokens to improve cache hits.
- Warmup: reserve 1 GPU for 48h and run 30 scripted sessions pre-launch.
- Streaming: enable streaming for interactive flows. Clients should render partials and call /accept to finalize.
- Debounce: recommend client debounce = 250ms. Coalesce identical rapid edits.
- Caching: prefix-cache system prompts + templates. Key = sha256(tenant|template_id|normalized_prefix). TTL = 9h.
- Batching: use continuous batching on server; set max_batch_delay_ms = 15 to keep interactive feel.
- Cost guardrails: per-session token cap = 12k; daily account cap = $320 -> AE notified at 120% of forecast.
- Surge mitigation: rate-limit new sessions per minute, auto-fallback to quantized model when util > 75% or p95 > 1s for 5m, reduce batch_size by 50% when falling back.
- Telemetry: must emit token_count, model_variant, latency_ms, cache_hit, route_tag. Hook to AE dashboard.
- Escalation: oncall SRE, EngOps lead, AE (contacts in Confluence).
Omar (SRE): Ops snippet for EngOps automation:
```json
{
  "tenant": "surgepilot",
  "warm_pool_gpus": 1,
  "cache_ttl_seconds": 32400,
  "max_batch_delay_ms": 15,
  "session_token_cap": 12000,
  "daily_cost_cap_usd": 320,
  "fallback_rules": [
    {"metric":"util_pct","op":">=","value":75,"action":"switch:quantized"},
    {"metric":"p95_latency_ms","op":">","value":1000,"action":"reduce_batch:0.5"}
  ],
  "rate_limits": {"new_sessions_per_min": 60}
}
```
Fel (AE): Renewal play: weekly digest + 24h alert. If 3-day rolling avg cost/session > target by 25%, AE schedules cost-review with CS + SRE + customer. Include sample email template in runbook.
Sasha (EngOps): Add manual rollback steps and `kubectl` quick commands to Confluence ops doc. Also add a simple smoke-test script for the warm pool.
Bea (CS): Ill publish a one-page PDF for the customer, a Confluence ops doc with snippets, and the AE alert template. Tagging this thread for the handoff call.
runbook-bot: Runbook created: /cs-runbooks/surgepilot-prefill-surge-mitigation-onepager - https://confluence.internal/surgepilot-runbook
Bea (CS): Thanks team 1 will finalize after the pre-launch sync.
